cause_quote: The connected-account change began storing `entry.authProfileOverrideSource = "user-link";`, which the existing fresh cron session sanitizer excluded with `if (source === "user")`.
user_saw: When migrating a cron job, Doctor could silently bind it to a different shared account instead of honoring the linked account or reporting that it was unavailable.
summary: The fix preserves linked authentication profile overrides when preparing fresh cron sessions.
reasoning: The connected-account commit introduced `user-link` as a distinct value returned by the provenance resolver, and I verified that the cron sanitizer at that commit preserved only `user`. Doctor later began reading explicit account selections from the prepared session, where a fresh session had already dropped the linked account.
